propositions: The workflow editor must expose a separate read-only Effective Policy view derived from CriteriaSnapshot alongside the editable Authored Workflow YAML/BPMN topology.
Creating or saving a project code-review LLM criterion with missing, empty, or non-list applies_to globs must be rejected with remedial guidance to use ["**"] for repository-wide application.
The Effective Policy panel displays snapshot source, criterion id, gate, tier, posture, applicability, and enabled state but never serializes mutations back into workflow or project routing.
Built-in triggers, project DET criteria, and plan-review criteria retain their distinct authoring controls and are exempt from the applies_to glob validation rule.
Snapshot load or validation failures mark Effective Policy unavailable with an actionable error and prevent save; defaults are never substituted silently.
Server and editor payloads exclude execution trace, prompt context, provider response, and secrets; authored documents round-trip byte-equivalently.
